info.title: Help Me Get Hired API
info.description: The routes the web app calls on behalf of a Candidate. Every schema is generated from `packages/shared`, so the document and the code cannot disagree. Every route except `/health` needs the Session bearer token Auth.js issues in the web app; paste the value of its `session` cookie.

servers.description: The API that serves this document; on the Docker Compose stack, http://localhost:API_PORT

tags.name: Account
tags.description: The signed-in Candidate's Account Information and Session

tags.name: Model Choice
tags.description: The Provider and Model an Account analyses with, and its Model Key

tags.name: Resumes
tags.description: Uploaded Resumes: the presigned upload, its completion, and the record's status

tags.name: Profile
tags.description: The Profile the Ingestion built and its confirmation

tags.name: Curation
tags.description: Profile Curation: the Statements built from the confirmed Profile, and their progress

get.description: Answers without a Session. Compose and the deployment target use it as the health check.
The Account Information of the signed-in Candidate: e-mail, name, phone, and address. Never a Profile field.

patch.description: Name, last name, phone with its country code, and an optional address, validated with the shared schema.

400.description: The body did not pass the shared schema; `issues` names each field

post.description: Deletes the Session the bearer token names. The web app clears its cookie afterwards.

get.description: The Provider, the Model, and whether a Model Key is stored; never the key or any part of it. An Account that has not chosen yet answers `choice: null`.

200.description: The Model Choice, or none yet

put.summary: Choose the Model and store the Model Key
put.description: Checks the key with the Provider without spending tokens, then stores it encrypted, replacing any earlier choice and key. Only the catalogue pairing is accepted. A refused key replaces nothing, and the key is never answered back. The page sends it with a Model Key ticket instead of the Session, so the key never passes through the web app; the ticket is spent before the key is checked, so a refused key needs a new one.

400.description: The body did not pass the shared schema; `unsupported_model_choice` when the Provider or the Model is not in the catalogue

401.description: Neither a live Session nor a valid Model Key ticket; `model_key_ticket_invalid` whether the ticket is unknown, expired, or used

422.description: `model_key_invalid` when the Provider does not accept the key; `model_key_not_permitted` when it does but not for the chosen Model

503.description: `provider_unavailable` when the Provider could not be reached to check the key

post.description: A single-use ticket for the Session's Account, valid for 60 seconds. The web app hands it to the page, which presents it as the bearer token of `PUT /account/model` to send the Model Key straight to the API. It is kept only as its SHA-256, and no other route accepts it.

201.description: The ticket and when it expires

delete.description: Deletes the stored key. The Model Choice stays, and no new analysis starts until another key is stored.

200.description: The choice, with no key stored

404.description: The Account has not chosen a Model yet

post.summary: Reserve an Uploaded Resume and get the presigned upload
post.description: Declares the file name, size, and SHA-256. Answers a pending record and a presigned PUT the browser sends the bytes to. The same bytes already uploaded answer the existing record with no upload to perform.

200.description: The existing record for the same bytes; `upload` is null once the file arrived, or a fresh URL while the record is still pending

201.description: A new record with its presigned upload

400.description: The body did not pass the shared schema; `issues` names each field

get.description: Newest first, with the Ingestion Progress of each record that has one.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Only the records in this status

400.description: The status is not one of the known ones

post.summary: Tell the API the bytes are in storage
post.description: Heads the object up to three times, 500 ms apart, marks the record uploaded, and adds the extraction job. Idempotent for a record no longer pending.

202.description: The record, uploaded and queued for extraction

404.description: The Account has no such record; another Account's id answers the same

409.description: `upload_incomplete` when the object is missing or has another size (the record stays pending); `ingestion_active` while another upload or Ingestion of the Account is in flight

get.summary: One Uploaded Resume with its status and Progress
get.description: The record with its status, its error code when failed, and the Ingestion Progress while the Profile is being built. The `ETag` changes with them; send it back as `If-None-Match` to poll cheaply.

ETag.description: Changes with the status, the error code, and the Progress

404.description: The Account has no such record; another Account's id answers the same

get.summary: The Profile built from the latest completed Ingestion
get.description: The seven parts, the years of experience derived from the Experiences with overlaps counted once, the review flags for the fields recognised with low Confidence, and the source Uploaded Resume. An Account with no completed Ingestion gets an empty Profile with no source.

post.description: Records the confirmation time once and clears the review flags until the next Ingestion replaces the rows. Idempotent.

404.description: No Profile has been built for the Account yet

put.description: Replaces the headline, summary, and the LinkedIn and GitHub URLs with what the Candidate says is true. Name, e-mail, phone and address are Account Information and are not part of this. Only until the Profile is confirmed.

200.description: The Profile as it now reads

400.description: The body did not pass the shared schema; `issues` names each field

404.description: The Account has no Profile, or no such entry in that part

409.description: The Profile is confirmed and takes no more corrections

post.summary: Add an entry the recognition missed
post.description: Adds one entry to the end of the part. The entry belongs to no Segment, because nothing was recognized for it, and counts as corrected from the start. The body is the part's entry without its id.

parameters.name: part
parameters.description: The Profile part the entry belongs to

200.description: The Profile as it now reads

400.description: The body did not pass the shared schema; `issues` names each field

404.description: The Account has no Profile, or no such entry in that part

409.description: The Profile is confirmed and takes no more corrections

put.description: Replaces the entry with what the Candidate says is true, keeping its place in the part and the Ingestion it came from.

parameters.name: part
parameters.description: The Profile part the entry belongs to

200.description: The Profile as it now reads

400.description: The body did not pass the shared schema; `issues` names each field

404.description: The Account has no Profile, or no such entry in that part

409.description: The Profile is confirmed and takes no more corrections

delete.summary: Remove an entry the recognition should not have written
delete.description: Removes the entry from the Profile. A new Ingestion writes the part again from the résumé.

parameters.name: part
parameters.description: The Profile part the entry belongs to

200.description: The Profile as it now reads

400.description: The body did not pass the shared schema; `issues` names each field

404.description: The Account has no Profile, or no such entry in that part

409.description: The Profile is confirmed and takes no more corrections

get.summary: The progress of the current Curation
get.description: The newest Curation of the Profile on screen: its status, the percentage of units saved, every unit with its kind, title, and status, the metrics counted from the Profile, the Model it runs on, and the failure reason with `resumeAfter` when it waits out a rate limit. The percentage counts saved units only, so every process answers the same number. An Account with no Curation for its latest Profile answers `progress: null`. Statements are not part of this answer. The `ETag` changes with any of it; send it back as `If-None-Match` to poll cheaply.

ETag.description: Changes with anything in the answer

get.summary: The Statements of the current Curation
get.description: Every Statement of the latest completed Curation, the one retrieval reads, in the order of its units: the sentence, its labels, its Evidence, the unit it came from, and its review. An Account with no completed Curation answers `curationId: null` with no Statements. A rejected Statement is listed here and never retrieved. A review is not carried to the Statements of a re-run.

put.description: Sets the review to `accepted` or `rejected`, recording when, or clears it back to `unreviewed`. A rejected Statement keeps its row and is left out of every retrieval; accepted and unreviewed Statements are both retrieved.

400.description: The body did not pass the shared schema; `issues` names each field

404.description: The Account has no such record; another Account's id answers the same

post.description: Moves the queued or running Curation to `cancelled`. The runner stops at its next unit boundary, the Statements already saved are kept for a retry, and nothing is indexed. Answers the progress as it now stands.

404.description: `curation_not_found` when no Curation is queued or running

post.summary: Try the failed or cancelled Curation again
post.description: Takes the newest Curation of the Profile, when it is `failed` or `cancelled`, back to `queued` with its attempts reset and its reason cleared, and adds its job again. Saved units stay saved, so the runner resumes at the first unsaved one and the Candidate pays only for what is left.

404.description: `curation_not_found` when the Profile has no Curation

409.description: `curation_active` while a Curation is queued or running

422.description: `curation_not_ready` before the Profile is confirmed and a Model Key stored; `curation_not_retryable` when the Curation is not failed or cancelled; `curation_model_changed` when the Model Choice changed since it started, which a re-run answers instead

post.summary: Run the Curation again from zero
post.description: Creates a new Curation beside the current completed one, which stays current and retrievable until the new one completes and supersedes it; a re-run that fails or is cancelled leaves it intact. It spends the Candidate's tokens, so it is allowed only when the newest Curation of the Profile failed or was cancelled, or the Profile, the Model, or the prompt version changed since the current one was produced.

202.description: The progress of the new Curation

409.description: `curation_active` while a Curation is queued or running

422.description: `curation_not_ready` before the Profile is confirmed and a Model Key stored; `curation_unchanged` when running it again would produce the same Statements

CurationStatements.description: The Statements of the current Curation, the latest completed one, which is what retrieval reads; `curationId: null` with no Statements until one completes. A review belongs to its Statement and is not carried to the Statements of a re-run, which have no stable identity to inherit it from.

session.description: The Session token the web app keeps in its `session` cookie after sign in

modelKeyTicket.description: A single-use Model Key ticket from `POST /account/model/key-ticket`; only `PUT /account/model` accepts it
